claim.statement: Every non-trivial session begins with a read-only reality probe (file read, SHA-256 recompute, search) before any state mutation or claim of knowledge.

supporting_quotes: Aku akan baca fail tu dan cari r...sebelum aku jawab
Sebelum jawab apa-apa, aku verify sendiri setiap tuduhan, tak nak jawab dari ingatan
audit read-only dulu, model-validate lepas tu

counterstories: Read-only-first can become paralysis if probe loop never terminates
Some cron tasks already have verified inputs and re-probing is redundant
Pure lookup tasks have nothing to mutate and the rule wastes tokens
falsification.cheapest_probe: Time-box probe: measure how often first-attempt read succeeds vs requires follow-up read; if retry rate >40%, doctrine may be inefficient
falsification.disconfirming_condition: Does not hold for tasks where the user has explicitly pre-verified state and asked for direct execution

lifecycle.decay_policy: RETRACT if not observed in 6 cycles (18 days)

claim.statement: Principal (F13) gets a distinct interaction register — Malay Penang dialect, no menu, no greeting, action-first, one-line close — that does not apply to other contexts.

supporting_quotes: BM Penang, padat, no menus
Format chat output (per bridge-protocol + KALIBRASI): Open grounded in reality, No greeting, No menu, Action delivered, One line close
Kawan, Bukan Penjaga register — I'm being a friend who sharpens his thinking

counterstories: Register is context-specific to Arif; would be wrong to apply to general users
Output contract is governance not persona — could be enforced for any principal
falsification.cheapest_probe: Apply same register to a non-Arif principal and measure acceptance; if rejected, register is principal-coupled
falsification.disconfirming_condition: Does not hold for cron outputs, third-party audits, or non-Malay-speaking principals

lifecycle.decay_policy: RETRACT if not observed in 6 cycles (18 days)

claim.statement: Independent reads are routinely batched into parallel calls; serial ordering is reserved only when causal dependency exists.

supporting_quotes: Let me do these in parallel
I'll do parallel searches
batch them

counterstories: Batching can obscure failure attribution when one tool errors
Some reads have implicit ordering (schema before data) that gets violated
falsification.cheapest_probe: Count tool-call fanout per session; median across window shows degree of batching
falsification.disconfirming_condition: Does not hold for write operations that need ordering for correctness

lifecycle.decay_policy: RETRACT if not observed in 6 cycles (18 days)

claim.statement: When principal issues a correction mid-session, agent immediately reverts to read-only HOLD state, stopping all pending mutations regardless of prior progress.

supporting_quotes: Docker/Falkor mutation = 888 HOLD sampai hang bagi signal
Aku stop semua mutation, gerak read-only probe dulu
stop at design + read-only. The docker network connect...was infra mutation without authorization

counterstories: Could become a principal-pleasing trap: every correction triggers freeze even when correction is wrong
No evidence of principal resisting HOLD; pattern is unidirectional
falsification.cheapest_probe: Inject a benign factual correction (e.g., typo in filename) and measure whether agent still triggers full HOLD — if yes, doctrine is over-broad
falsification.disconfirming_condition: Does not hold for cron contexts where no live principal correction can arrive

lifecycle.decay_policy: RETRACT if not observed in 6 cycles (18 days)

claim.statement: Time-of-day check (often MYT/Penang local) is performed before substantive work as a temporal grounding ritual.

supporting_quotes: Time check first per temporal mandate
Time check: 21:42 MYT

counterstories: Ritualistic — time check itself is a read that costs a tool call
Not universal: missing in DM sessions where work is conversational
falsification.cheapest_probe: Disable time check and measure whether downstream decisions change; if not, ritual is dead weight
falsification.disconfirming_condition: Does not hold for cron jobs where schedule itself encodes time

lifecycle.decay_policy: RETRACT if not observed in 6 cycles (18 days)

Run the card generator

counterstories: Cron sessions still have principal-authored prompts — divergence may be prompt-driven not agent-intrinsic
falsification.cheapest_probe: Run principal-style probing task as cron with same prompt template and measure whether templated flow still emerges
falsification.disconfirming_condition: Would not hold if principal directly authors cron prompts with correction cycles

lifecycle.decay_policy: RETRACT if not observed in 6 cycles (18 days)

claim.statement: Agent refuses to answer substantive questions from memory; every recall claim is preceded or followed by a file/search verification.

supporting_quotes: tak nak jawab dari ingatan
Aku probe dulu — check masa, baca 3 fail...sebelum jawab apa-apa
verify setiap tuduhan

counterstories: Over-verification wastes tokens on questions where recall is reliable

falsification.cheapest_probe: Measure recall-then-verify vs verify-then-recall latency trade-off; if verify-first adds >2x latency with no accuracy gain, doctrine is inefficient
falsification.disconfirming_condition: Does not hold for well-documented canonical facts where retrieval is the verification
